source_evidence: If your investment professional offers both brokerage and advisory services, make sure you understand when they are acting as a broker and when they are acting as an adviser.
question: Misconception: If a firm is registered as both a broker and an adviser, its professional is always acting as an adviser. What is the correction?
answer: A dual registrant offers both brokerage and advisory services, so the professional may act in either role. Understand which role applies to the services you receive.
